note: NECO Financial Accounting round 5 (R28 top-up): equation arithmetic 85,000, van-for-cash mix, credit purchase double entry; purchases returns day book, journal proper, petty cash, cash sales in the cash book; contra entry, discount allowed as expense, three columns; standing order, credit transfer, unpresented cheques raising the statement balance; repainting as revenue, warehouse plus legal fees as capital; net purchases, COGS 75,000; prepaid rent asset, accrued commission, accrued electricity liability; current ratio 2:1, gross margin 30%; reducing-balance book value 32,000; subscriptions in advance; interest on drawings credited to appropriation; current account credit balance; balance c/d on the smaller side; one-sided posting breaks the trial balance; TB purpose; carriage outwards in P&L; bad debts recovered; provision as debtors' deduction; imprest reimbursement; supplier's invoice; cash discount recorded; purchases ledger. Scanned against NECO rounds 1-4, WAEC Accounting (all rounds) and the JAMB pool.
